1.1: Meematay mazkirin gevurot geshamim. rabbi eliezer omer, miyyom tov harishon shel chag. rabbi yehoshua omer, miyyom tov haacharon shel chag. amar lo rabbi yehoshua. hoil veen haggeshamim ella siman kelala bechag, lamma mazkir. amar lo rabbi eliezer, af ani lo amarti lishol, ella lehazekir mashshiv haruach umorid haggeshem beonato. amar lo, im ken, leolam yehe mazkir:
1.2: En shoalin et haggeshamim ella samuch laggeshamim. rabbi yehuda omer, haover lifne hatteva beyom tov haacharon shel chag, haacharon mazkir, harishon eno mazkir. beyom tov harishon shel pesach, harishon mazkir, haacharon eno mazkir. ad ematay shoalin et haggeshamim, rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyaavor happasach. rabbi meir omer, ad sheyyetze nisan, shenneemar (Yoel b) vayyored lachem geshem, more umalkosh barishon:
1.3: Bishlosha vemarcheshvan shoalin et haggeshamim. rabban gamliel omer, beshiva vo, chamishsha asar yom achar hechag, kede sheyyaggia acharon shebbeyisrael linhar perat:
1.4: Higgia shiva asar bemarcheshvan velo yardu geshamim, hitchilu hayechidim mitannin shalosh taaniyyot. ochlin veshotin mishshechashecha, umuttarin bimlacha uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta:
1.5: Higgia rosh chodesh kislev velo yardu geshamim, bet din gozrin shalosh taaniot al hatztzibbur. ochlin veshotin mishshechashecha, umuttarin bimlacha uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta:
1.6: Avru ellu velo naanu, bet din gozrin shalosh taaniyyot acherot al hatztzibbur. ochlin veshotin mibbeod yom, vaasurin bimlacha uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta, venoalin et hammerchatzaot. avru ellu velo naanu, bet din gozrin alehem od sheva, shehen shelosh esre taaniyyot al hatztzibbur. hare ellu yeterot al harishonot, shebbaellu matriin venoalin et hachanuyot, bashsheni mattin im chashecha, uvachamishi muttarin mippene chevod hashshabbat:
1.7: Avru ellu velo naanu, memaatin bemassa umattan, bevinyan uvintia, beerusin uvenissuin uvishelat shalom ben adam lachavero, kivne adam hannezufin lammakom. hayechidim chozrim umitannim ad sheyyetze nisan. yatza nisan velo yardu geshamim, siman kelala, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 12) halo ketzir chittim hayyom, vegomer:

2.1: Seder taaniyyot ketzad, motziin et hatteva lirchovah shel ir, venotnin efer mikle al gabbe hatteva, uverosh hannasi uverosh av bet din, vechol echad veechad noten berosho. hazzaken shebbahen omer lifnehen divre chibbushin, achenu, lo neemar beanshe ninve, vayyar haelohim et sakkam veet taanitam, ella (Yona 3) vayyar haelohim et maasehem, ki shavu middarkam haraa. uvakkabbala hu omer (Yoel b) vekiru levavchem veal bigdechem:
2.2: Amdu vitfilla, moridin lifne hatteva zaken veragil, veyesh lo vanim, uveto rekam, kede sheyyehe libbo shalem battefilla, veomer lifnehem esrim vearba berachot, shemone esre shebbechol yom, umosif alehen od shesh:
2.3: Veellu hen, zichronot, veshofarot, el Adonai batztzarata li karati vayyaaneni (Tehillim 120:1), essa enay el heharim vegomer (sham 121), mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai (sham 130), tefilla leani chi yaatof (sham kav). rabbi yehuda omer, lo haya tzarich lomar zichronot veshofarot, ella omer tachtehen, raav ki yihye vaaretz (Melachim 1 8, 37), dever ki yihye vegomer, asher haya devar Adonai el yirmeyahu al divre habbatztzarot (yirmeya yad). veomer chotmehen:
2.4: Al harishona hu omer, mi sheana et avraham behar hammoriyya, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai goel yisrael. al hashsheniyya hu omer, mi sheana et avotenu al yam sof, hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai zocher hannishkachot. al hashshelishit hu omer, mi sheana et yehoshua baggilgal, hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai shomea terua. al harviit hu omer, mi sheana et shemuel bammitzpa, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai shomea tzeaka. al hachamishit hu omer, mi sheana et eliyyahu behar hakkarmel, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla. al hashshishshit hu omer, mi sheana et yona mimmee haddaga, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai haone beet tzara. al hashsheviit hu omer, mi sheana et david veet shelomo veno birushalayim, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai hamerachem al haaretz:
2.5: Maase vime rabbi chalafta verabbi chananya ven teradyon, sheavar echad lifne hatteva vegamar et habberacha chullah, velo anu acharav amen. tiku hakkohanim tekau. mi sheana et avraham avinu behar hammoriyya hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze. hariu bene aharon hariu. mi sheana et avotenu al yam sof, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze. ucheshebba davar etzel chachamim, amru, lo hayinu nohagin ken ella veshaar mizrach uvehar habbayit:
2.6: Shalosh taaniyyot harishonot, anshe mishmar mitannin velo mashlimin, veanshe vet av lo hayu mitannin kelal. shalosh sheniyyot, anshe mishmar mitannin umashlimin, veanshe vet av mitannin velo mashlimin. sheva acharonot, ellu vaellu mitannin umashlimin, divre rabbi yehoshua. vachachamim omrim, shalosh taaniyyot harishonot, ellu vaellu lo hayu mitannin kelal. shalosh sheniyyot, anshe mishmar mitannin velo mashlimin, veanshe vet av lo hayu mitannin kelal. sheva acharonot, anshe mishmar mitannin umashlimin, veanshe vet av mitannin velo mashlimin:
2.7: Anshe mishmar muttarim lishtot yayin ballelot, aval lo vayyamim. veanshe vet av, lo vayyom velo vallayla. anshe mishmar veanshe maamad asurin millesapper umillechabbes, uvachamishi muttarin mippene chevod hashshabbat:
2.8: Kol hakkatuv bimgillat taanit delo lemispad, lefanav asur, leacharav muttar. rabbi yose omer, lefanav uleacharav asur. delo lehitannaa vehon, lefanav uleacharav muttar. rabbi yose omer, lefanav asur, leacharav muttar:
2.9: En gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur battechilla bachamishi, shello lehafekia hashshearim, ella shalosh taaniyyot harishonot sheni vachamishi vesheni, veshalosh sheniyyot chamishi sheni vachamishi. rabbi yose omer, keshem sheen harishonot bachamishi, kach lo sheniyyot velo acharonot:
2.10: En gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur berosh chodesh, bachanukka uvefurim, veim hitchilu, en mafsikin, divre rabban gamliel. amar rabbi meir, af al pi sheamar rabban gamliel en mafsikin, mode haya sheen mashlimin. vechen tisha veav shechal lihyot beerev shabbat:

3.1: Seder taaniyyot elu haamur, birvia rishona. aval tzemachim sheshshanu, matriin alehem miyyad. vechen sheppasku geshamim ben geshem legeshem arbaim yom, matriin alehem miyyad, mippene shehi makkat batztzoret:
3.2: Yardu latztzemachin aval lo yardu lailan, lailan velo latztzemachim, laze velaze aval lo labborot lashshichin velammearot, matriin alehen miyyad:
3.3: Vechen ir shello yardu aleha geshamim, dichtiv (Amos 4) vehimtarti al ir echat veal ir achat lo amtir, chelka achat timmater vegomer, otah hair mitanna umatraat, vechol sevivoteha, mitannot velo matriot. rabbi akiva omer, matriot velo mitannot:
3.4: Vechen ir sheyyesh bah dever o mappolet, otah hair mitanna umatraat, vechol sevivoteha mitannot velo matriot. rabbi akiva omer, matriot velo mitannot. ezehu dever, ir hammotzia chamesh meot ragli, veyatzu mimmenna shelosha metim bishlosha yamim ze achar ze, hare ze dever. pachot mikkan, en ze dever:
3.5: Al ellu matriin bechol makom, al hashshiddafon veal hayyerakon, al haarbe veal hechasil, veal hachayya raa veal hacherev, matriin aleha, mippene shehi makka mehallechet:
3.6: Maase sheyyardu zekenim mirushalayim learehem, vegazru taanit al shennira chimlo fi tannur shiddafon beashkelon. veod gazru taanit al sheachlu zeevim shene tinokot beever hayyarden. rabbi yose omer, lo al sheachlu, ella al shennira:
3.7: Al ellu matriin beshabbat, al ir shehikkifuha goyim o nahar, veal hassefina hammittarefet bayyam. rabbi yose omer, leezra velo litzaka. shimon hattimni omer, af al haddever, velo hodu lo chachamim:
3.8: Al kol tzara shello tavo al hatztzibbur, matriin alehen, chutz merov geshamim. maase sheamru lo lechoni hameaggel, hitpallel sheyyerdu geshamim. amar lahem, tzeu vehachenisu tannure fesachim, bishvil shello yimmoku. hitpallel, velo yardu geshamim. me asa, ag uga veamad betochah, veamar lefanav, ribbono shel olam, banecha samu fenehem alay, sheani cheven bayit lefanecha. nishba ani veshimcha haggadol sheeni zaz mikkan, ad shetterachem al banecha. hitchilu geshamim menattefin. amar, lo chach shaalti, ella gishme vorot shichin umearot. hitchilu lered bezaaf. amar, lo chach shaalti, ella gishme ratzon, beracha unedava. yardu chetiknan, ad sheyyatzu yisrael mirushalayim lehar habbayit mippene haggeshamim. bau veamru lo, keshem shehitpalalta alehem sheyyerdu kach hitpallel sheyyelchu lahen. amar lahen, tzeu ureu im nimchet even hattoim. shalach lo shimon ben shatach, ilmale choni atta, gozrani alecha nidduy. aval ma eese lecha, sheatta mitchatte lifne hammakom veose lecha retzoncha keven shehu mitchatte al aviv veose lo retzono. vealecha hakkatuv omer (Mishlei 23), yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha:
3.9: Hayu mitannin veyardu lahem geshamim kodem hanetz hachamma, lo yashlimu. leachar hanetz hachamma, yashlimu. rabbi eliezer omer, kodem chatzot lo yashlimu, leachar chatzot yashlimu. maase sheggazru taanit belod, veyardu lahem geshamim kodem chatzot. amar lahem rabbi tarfon, tzeu veichlu ushetu vaasu yom tov. veyatzu veachlu veshatu veasu yom tov, uvau ben haarbayim vekaru hallel haggadol:

4.1: Bishlosha ferakim bashshana kohanim nosin et kappehen arba peamim bayyom, bashshacharit, bammusaf uvammincha uvinilat shearim, battaaniyyot uvammaamadot uveyom hakkippurim:
4.2: Ellu hen maamadot, lefi shenneemar (Bamidbar 28), tzav et bene yisrael veamarta alehem et karbani lachmi, vechi heach karbano shel adam karev, vehu eno omed al gabbav, hitkinu neviim harishonim esrim vearba mishmarot. al kol mishmar umishmar haya maamad birushalayim shel kohanim, shel leviyyim, veshel yisreelim. higgia zeman hammishmar laalot, kohanim uleviyyim olim lirushalayim, veyisrael shebbeoto mishmar mitkannesin learehen vekorin bemaase vereshit:
4.3: Veanshe hammaamad hayu mitannin arbaa yamim bashshavua, miyyom sheni vead yom chamishi. velo hayu mitannin erev shabbat, mippene chevod hashshabbat. velo veechad bashshabbat, kede shello yetzu mimmenucha vaoneg ligia vetaanit veyamutu. bayyom harishon, bereshit, viyhi rakia. bashsheni, yehi rakia, veyikkavu hammayim. bashshelishi, yikkavu hammayim, viyhi meorot. barvii, yehi meorot, veyishretzu hammayim. bachamishi, yishretzu hammayim, vetotze haaretz. bashshishshi, totze haaretz, vaychullu hashshamayim. parasha gedola, korin otah bishnayim, vehakketanna beyachid, bashshacharit uvammusaf. uvammincha nichnasin vekorin al pihen, kekorin et shema. erev shabbat bammincha lo hayu nichnasin, mippene chevod hashshabbat:
4.4: Kol yom sheyyesh bo hallel, en bo maamad bashshacharit. karban musaf, en bo vanneila. karban etzim, en bo vammincha, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo ven azzay, kach haya rabbi yehoshua shone, karban musaf, en bo vammincha. karban etzim, en bo vanneila. chazar rabbi akiva lihyot shone cheven azzay:
4.5: Zeman atze chohanim vehaam, tisha. beechad benisan, bene arach ben yehuda. beesrim betammuz, bene david ben yehuda. bachamishsha veav, bene farosh ben yehuda. beshiva vo, bene yonadav ben rechav. baasara vo, bene senaa ven binyamin. bachamishsha asar bo, bene zattu ven yehuda, veimmahem kohanim uleviyyim vechol mi shettaa veshivto, uvene gonve eli bene kotze ketziot. beesrim bo, bene fachat moav ben yehuda. beesrim beelul, bene adin ben yehuda. beechad betevet shavu vene farosh sheniyya. beechad betevet lo haya vo maamad, shehaya vo hallel vekarban musaf vekarban etzim:
4.6: Chamishsha devarim eru et avotenu beshiva asar betammuz vachamishsha betisha veav. beshiva asar betammuz nishtabberu halluchot, uvatal hattamid, vehuvkea hair, vesaraf appostomos et hattora, veheemid tzelem bahechol. betisha veav nigzar al avotenu shello yikkansu laaretz, vecharav habbayit barishona uvashsheniyya, venilkeda vetar, venechresha hair. mishshennichnas av, memaatin besimcha:
4.7: Shabbat shechal tisha veav lihyot betochah, asur millesapper umillechabbes, uvachamishi muttarin mippene chevod hashshabbat. erev tisha veav lo yochal adam shene tavshilin, lo yochal basar velo yishte yayin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, yeshanne. rabbi yehuda mechayyev bichfiyyat hammitta, velo hodu lo chachamim:
4.8: Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, lo hayu yamim tovim leyisrael kachamishsha asar beav ucheyom hakkippurim, shebbahen benot yerushalayim yotzot bichle lavan sheulin, shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo. kol hakkelim teunin tevila. uvenot yerushalayim yotzot vecholot bakkeramim. ume hayu omrot, bachur, sa na enecha uree, ma atta vorer lach. al titten enecha vannoy, ten enecha vammishpacha. sheker hachen vehevel hayyofi, ishsha yirat Adonai hi tithallal (Mishlei lo). veomer, tenu lah mipperi yadeha, vihalluha vashshearim maaseha. vechen hu omer, tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo immo beyom chatunnato uveyom simchat libbo (Shir hashshirim 3). beyom chatunnato, ze mattan tora. uveyom simchat libbo, ze binyan bet hammikdash, sheyyibbane vimhera veyamenu. amen:
